title: David Jay Brown's field guide to DMT entities: machine elves and insectoid surgeons

tellings.quote: you know, to describe and there's a book by David J. Brown, illustrated field guide to DMT entities,

plain: A book by the writer David Jay Brown, the Illustrated Field Guide to DMT Entities, sets out to catalogue the beings people say they meet on DMT, a powerful psychedelic drug. These include the "machine elves" made famous by the writer Terence McKenna and insect-like figures that seem to operate on the user. The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore mentions the book to Michels as an example of how people try to describe these encounters, which matters to him because so many users report meeting similar beings.
